Patient Care Coordinator — San Luis Obispo & Templeton

Company Description

MK Larson Audiology is a privately owned, patient-centered audiology practice providing comprehensive, high-quality hearing healthcare to patients throughout the Central Coast. We pride ourselves on longer appointment times, thoughtful patient education, personalized care, and a high standard of clinical and administrative accuracy.

We are seeking an exceptional Patient Care Coordinator (PCC) who is warm, professional, highly organized, and committed to creating an outstanding patient experience. This is an important role within our practice: our PCCs are often the first point of contact for our patients and help ensure that every aspect of their care is handled thoughtfully and accurately.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site position supporting our San Luis Obispo and Templeton locations. The primary work location will be San Luis Obispo, with scheduled coverage and responsibilities at our Templeton location as needed.

The Patient Care Coordinator is responsible for scheduling and coordinating patient care, answering phones, welcoming patients, communicating with referring offices, verifying insurance benefits, collecting payments, and ensuring administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys interacting with people but is equally strong behind the scenes. We are looking for someone who notices details, anticipates what needs to happen next, follows through without repeated reminders, and takes genuine ownership of their responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide a warm, professional first impression in person and over the phone
* Schedule and coordinate patient appointments across our San Luis Obispo and Templeton locations
* Manage incoming calls, messages, scheduling requests, and patient questions efficiently
* Verify insurance benefits and accurately communicate anticipated patient financial responsibility
* Assist with prior authorizations, referrals, and insurance-related follow-up
* Collect and accurately process patient payments
* Maintain accurate patient records, documentation, and demographic/insurance information
* Coordinate communication between patients, audiologists, physicians, referring offices, and other healthcare providers
* Monitor outstanding tasks and follow through until they are fully resolved
* Assist with maintaining efficient patient flow and day-to-day front-office operations
* Provide coverage at both practice locations as scheduled
* Identify potential problems proactively and communicate them to the appropriate team member
* Contribute to a professional, collaborative, patient-focused work environment

Qualifications

Prior medical-office experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience with insurance verification, referrals, authorizations, medical scheduling, or billing workflows.

The successful candidate will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational abilities, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing track of follow-up.

Candidates should also be comfortable working independently, taking initiative, receiving feedback, and collaborating closely with a small team.

What We Value

We place a particularly high value on reliability, accountability, attention to detail, proactive communication, and follow-through. We want someone who takes pride in their work and understands that small administrative details can make a significant difference in a patient’s experience.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is kind and patient-centered, takes ownership of their responsibilities, and wants to become a trusted, long-term member of our practice.

Why Join MK Larson Audiology

MK Larson Audiology offers the opportunity to work in a growing, independent healthcare practice where patient care comes first. You’ll work closely with audiologists and a collaborative team while developing valuable experience in healthcare administration, insurance, patient coordination, and specialty medical care.

There is also opportunity for professional growth and increased responsibility for the right person as our practice continues to expand.

Position Details

Full-time, on-site
Locations: San Luis Obispo and Templeton, California
